method.scenarios: 22 sources x 2 strategies; 7 repeats above 10kB, 21 otherwise; equal initialization/warmups; order rotated; GC and external validation outside compile; completed map returned inside timed call
method.corpus: 4155 distinct Lua; one paired sample per strategy; 7 known exhaustive traps checked separately
method.focus: 21 deterministic time-quantile/high-overhead selections x 2 strategies; 3 repetitions, not corpus weighted
method.distribution: R7 quantiles; ceil(n/10) samples for upper/lower tail means; medians per variant; no deletion of slower samples

selection.trigger: at least 3% observed slowdown in either mode among successful primary scenes

rejectedTrials.trial: Existing sha2 force-soft-compact backend, wasm32-only feature
rejectedTrials.reason: 7/21-repetition paired WASM comparison failed to improve map latency and slowed lexical-only maps about 7-13%. The original SHA-256 backend is retained, and no dependency or format change is adopted.

rejectedTrials.trial: Compiler enum-tag direct JSON spelling and direct hex-string formatting
rejectedTrials.reason: Exact output matched, but the incremental WASM probe did not establish a map-generation benefit on lexical-only inputs. Avoid maintaining redundant encoding cases for an unproven gain. The numeric small-integer shortcut is assessed separately.

scope: Further reduce both mapped and plain compilation time; do not delay map output, change search, relax fidelity or slow the denominator.
